name: Quake Champions (Ranger, a medium)

scale.why: the game's own metres: the patch notes write 2.5 m = 100 u and 0.5 m = 20 u, so 40 u = 1 m (0.025 m/u); champions vary in size, so not rescaled to 1.8 m

speed.note: the developer's published number; lights 320 (Anarki, Nyx, Slash...), heavies 300; Ranger is a medium

air_accel.note: if Quake Champions keeps Quake III's air formula (accel toward the wish speed; Quake III's is 1): Quark-equivalent 0.9057 / 10. The formula isn't published (x0.0412 is outside the editor's 0.1..5 range: applying it clamps.)

air_cap.source: https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/2fSdxgKqKYKgsyeOmggmuU (base speed 310: the wish speed a Quake III-style air push aims at)

dash.note: champion abilities only (several champions have dashes or blinks)

maxSpeed.note: Ranger's listed top speed (600 u/s); forum posts cite a 680 u/s cap for light champions

anarkiFriction.source: https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/2fSdxgKqKYKgsyeOmggmuU (Anarki and Sorlag: friction 9 -> 8; circle strafe friction 15 -> 12 / 14)
anarkiFriction.note: per-champion friction; the other champions' values aren't published (9 before this patch for these two)

slayerDoubleJump.source: https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/4ii1II7x0GWYdL28HEOJ34 (Fall 2021 update: DOOM Slayer double jump velocity 7.5 -> 6.875 m/s)

extras: per-champion base speed, air acceleration and friction (light / medium / heavy)
bunny hopping and strafe jumping with a speed cap per champion
champion active abilities (dashes, teleports, a hoverboard...)
notes: Base speeds and air acceleration are the developer's published numbers (June 2018 patch notes, which also give the 40 u = 1 m scale). Gravity, jump speed, ground acceleration and the air formula aren't published, so the air mapping is an estimate (assumes Quake III's formula).

sources.title: Steam discussion: Quake Champions speed cap
